ordered_branches.explanation: Builds grouped inventory/allocation-request rows selected by nonzero wave OR nonzero shipment ID, so supplying both widens scope. Fixed direction branch matches destination warehouse/location/attribute ID; other direction matches source scope plus null-safe logistics unit and positive allocated quantity. Both match item, null-safe company/lot. Groups allocation quantities with shipment ID and inventory balances. Identity-order loop accumulates deductions only across consecutive equal warehouse/location/item/lot/logistics-unit/attribute tuples; INSERT has no ORDER BY and tuple omits company, so inferred running balances depend on insertion order and may cross company boundaries. One direction adjusts in-transit, otherwise allocated balances in the table variable. Inserts transaction type200 with ALLOCSUM quantity, before/after inferred balances and second-precision UTC timestamps; after expiration/status retained only if summed balances>0. It does not change LOCATION_INVENTORY or allocation requests.
